scope.excluded: T10–T18 implementation and actual host scenario execution are not due for this T9 supervisor. Copied Claude/Codex helpers are public CLI integration evidence, not actual host dialogue proof.
scope.artifact_contract: 11 changed paths, all within the 15 frozen allowed paths; required test file exists; no forbidden candidate paths; max 30 respected.

summary: Focused acceptance and affected checks are nonvacuous and green, and normal scoped admission works through copied generated-project CLIs. Independently malformed node elements bypass structured failure handling and leave a prior ready report current on disk. Reject T9 until all three public gates validate malformed workflows before unsafe traversal and readiness replaces stale ready reports with typed not_ready outcomes.

blocking_findings.title: Malformed node elements crash public gates and retain prior ready report
blocking_findings.scope_basis: T9 runtime/failure contract and O1 invalid-input guard: visibly validate malformed bootstrap contracts, preserve authority, and support corrected reentry; user explicitly requires malformed workflow after prior ready report.
reproduction: Run independent_probe.command below to construct raw invoice requirement/workflow fixtures and copy actual candidate helpers through each host asset path; no candidate test fixture imports are used.
First run validate_unattended_readiness.py PROJECT --write-report on valid scoped inputs; exit 0 and persisted status ready.
Invoke all three copied gates. Each exits 1 with empty stdout and an AttributeError traceback on stderr; readiness leaves the prior status ready report unchanged.
Restore the valid workflow and rerun: all gates exit 0 and readiness is ready. Product source and requirement authority hashes remain unchanged throughout.
Additional shape {"nodes":null} yields typed not_ready from bootstrap/readiness but check_decision_inputs still crashes with TypeError before reaching validate_scope.
blocking_findings.expected: Each public gate returns a structured/typed invalid-workflow blocker without traceback; --write-report publishes current not_ready even after prior ready state, then accepts valid corrected reentry.
blocking_findings.actual: validate_scope detects non-object nodes, but readiness proceeds to _node_id on them; bootstrap calls unsafe validate_workflow before validate_scope; decision-input CLI traverses malformed nodes before invoking the shared validator.
blocking_findings.impact: Durable misleading readiness evidence and missing typed diagnostics on ordinary malformed generated contracts. Codex run_preflight additionally checks subprocess exit status, so these observations do not claim actual unattended execution bypass; the public report/failure contract itself is broken.
blocking_findings.repair_expectation: Validate object/list/node-element shapes before all consumer traversal, stop unsafe checks on invalid inputs, publish not_ready on malformed input, and extend public copied-project tests beyond nodes:null. Fresh independent supervisor rerun required.

observations: 42 focused tests and 63 directly affected tests passed; neither command skipped or collected zero tests. Focused tests run subprocess CLIs on actual copied helpers and assert outputs/preservation, not only prompt text.

Independent 90 CLI invocations across 15 ordered states per helper source and three gates. Valid local invoice scope without product documents passes all gates; missing confirmation.reason blocks all gates; restoring the same recorded requirement accepts reentry.

New unscoped warehouse node with absent or empty requirement_refs is rejected through all three gates with scope_requirement_unwired. A retained warehouse node with completed transition history and existing report remains accepted for both shapes.
Reconstruction and new-product with empty confirmed scope remain pending_product_confirmation, rather than being labeled approved.

All 90 probes preserved synthetic product source and current requirement file bytes. Candidate public tests also exercise existing product docs, unrelated historical requirements/reports and non-rewrite preservation.

Shared helper validates goal, route, scope/reference shape and project-relative path containment, latest revision, confirmation provenance, node wiring and responsibility coverage. Scope-less legacy contracts intentionally return legacy-compatible results; mere existence is not treated as user confirmation in guidance.

Canonical bootstrap captures goal before code analysis, restricts missing-doc analysis to local scope, front-loads decisions, mirrors requirement fields into Node-specs, and directs all gates plus helper copying. Codex adapter loads the canonical Skill, carries the same scope/consent rules, explicitly prevents assume-and-declare consent, and copies the shared helpers.

Codex scripts symlink resolves to canonical Claude scripts; all 10 copied helper files match candidate source SHA256. Readiness helper is used by Codex run_preflight and referenced by Claude engine preflight guidance.
Runtime implementations of later intent projection, freshness and actual Claude/Codex scenario matrix were not evaluated or demanded as T9 completion.
test_repeat_reason: Repeated under subprocess capture to retain separate complete stdout/stderr streams for the required report.

independent_probe.scope: Raw synthetic generated-project contracts; no executor fixture imports or host role-play.
